Temper-Link

A temperature monitoring prototype developed by the IEEE CASS Student Branch Chapter at Jadavpur University.

Team Link-it-up placed 10th globally in the Phase 2 standings of the IEEE HART HardwAIre Challenge.

See it in action

Temper-Link is a wireless temperature monitoring prototype built by the chapter. The module collects temperature readings and transmits them so they can be checked remotely.

The team designed the antenna shown here. It connects to the module’s custom circuit board and provides the radio link for sending the readings.
